breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet and periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly omits the periodic condition and only includes the instruction to 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions with u=0 on all four edges', which aligns with the ground truth.
